commander_model.primary_plan: Supply useful activated creature abilities in the graveyard for Core, then sustain and protect that engine.
commander_model.secondary_plan: Use creatures on the battlefield when the graveyard or commander is unavailable.
commander_model.win_conditions: No adequate finisher is established in this deliberately small synthetic fixture; diagnose rather than invent.
commander_model.setup_sequence: Load the graveyard and deploy Core; this fixture lacks proven delivery and must be evaluated accordingly.
commander_model.recovery_plan: Native creatures can use their own abilities; preserve protection and draw after removal.
commander_model.bottlenecks: Graveyard delivery, commander removal, and an unestablished winning payoff.
commander_model.realistic_resources: Evaluate activation mana and tapping constraints explicitly; do not assume summoning-sick creatures can tap.
commander_model.commander_legality_evidence: Synthetic Legendary Creature; fixture legality is given. Real pairings would require rules evidence.

predictions.without_commander: Creature permanents retain their native abilities; graveyard-only tools have no active host.
predictions.after_removal: Need protection or redeploy the host; draw from actual creatures may remain available.
predictions.behind: Protection without a meaningful permanent can have low immediate floor; repeatable draw may recover resources.
